blocks.text: Project: St John

When we were approached by a local church in Yate to restore their original front door, we saw it as more than just a job, it was a chance to honour heritage through craftsmanship. At Scott Brothers UK, we’re passionate about restoration and reclamation, especially when it involves preserving the character of listed buildings.

Unfortunately, the existing timber door was far too rotten and worn to be saved. After a thorough assessment, it became clear that a full replacement was the only viable option. We sourced premium Canadian White Oak to craft the new door, ensuring strength, longevity, and a beautiful grain that complements the church’s façade. We were also able to salvage and restore some of the original door furniture, which received a deep clean and polish before being reinstalled, adding a touch of authenticity to this bespoke project.

While this particular door was made from solid oak, the project reflects our broader expertise, where we combine heritage aesthetics with modern materials for long-lasting performance. Design the best garden in Stoke Gifford

blocks.text: Project: Shepherd - Garden Consultancy

At Scott Brothers UK, we specialise in transforming challenging outdoor spaces into stylish, low-maintenance gardens that suit modern lifestyles. One of our recent projects in Yate involved a uniquely shaped garden that required expert planning and creative execution, an ideal showcase of our garden consultancy services.

Our clients wanted a contemporary look with minimal upkeep. We began by replacing the worn decking with stunning Fossil Indian Sandstone, chosen for its natural tones and durability. To complement the hardscape, we installed 37mm artificial grass, offering year-round greenery without the hassle of mowing or watering. The area was framed with a treated sleeper border, adding structure and a clean, modern finish.

To enhance privacy and define the space, we added partial new fencing that blended seamlessly with the existing layout. At the front of the property, we enclosed the garden with classic picket fencing and a matching gate, creating a welcoming entrance. A layer of Cotswold gravel completed the transformation, adding texture and improving drainage while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic.

This project highlights how our garden consultancy team combines practical design with visual appeal. Whether you're dealing with awkward layouts, sloping terrain, or simply want a fresh look, we tailor every solution to your needs and property style.
Scott Brothers UK offers expert garden consultancy across the south west.
From concept to completion, we deliver outdoor spaces that are functional, beautiful, and built to last. Contact us today to explore how we can help you reimagine your garden with confidence.
